releases.name: Version 0.2.1
releases.body:
- 1st Place Jam Winner!
- Added Chinese (Simplified) translation (thanks redsu721!)
- Flipped the `keepLoaded` status of some objects to prevent them from being visible outside of the dimension they belong to

releases.name: Version 0.2.0
releases.body:
- Added additional gameplay objects to Slate's campsite
- Added a small additional story beat to an early sequence
- Added visual feedback when returning to a location after completing objectives
- Added a gravity field to a precarious location to prevent accidentally being flung away
- Changed the visuals for some clues in a central location for better clarity
- Fixed certain objects not interacting with the new tool while socketed
- Fixed an issue with 3D-positioned audio falling out of sync with the player
- Fixed several softlocks related to holding the new tool while flying the ship
- Fixed an important location being visible (and accessible!) without entering the surrounding area first
- Fixed a softlock when being kicked out of the dream world while looking through a peephole
- Partially fixed an issue with the pictures taken by the new tool being displayed incorrectly
